description: This file defines the PHP class 'Inspector2Client' in the namespace 'Aws\Inspector2', which extends the 'AwsClient' class. It includes PHPDoc annotations for numerous methods related to the AWS Inspector2 service, indicating the available API operations and their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: Inspector2Client
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS Inspector2 service, providing methods for each API operation.

methods.name: associateMember
methods.description: Associates a member account with the Inspector2 service.

methods.name: batchGetAccountStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of multiple accounts.

methods.description: Creates a new filter for findings.

methods.name: updateOrganizationConfiguration
methods.description: Updates the organization configuration for Inspector2.
